_comment: Tổ đội and bí cảnh (spec 14, 15.3). Seconds, pixels, percentages of max HP.
_rift_comment: Khe Nứt Mực: every check_seconds, each channel of a zone listed here that has players may tear one open (chance), at most max_open at once in the world. What spills out are the creatures of that land and of the khu where it opened (realms.json khe_nut_muc.quai, app/systems/realm_quai.py), so every wild land of Luyện Khí is listed.
_seal_comment: Trận Nhãn: the room opens after base + per_member x (other members who can be asked) broken seals, at most as many as the room has; fail_pct = % of max HP a wrong or late answer costs the one who gave it; retry_seconds = how long that player waits before a seal asks them again.
_room_loot_by_realm_comment: Each realm's loot for a cleared room. A math bí cảnh pays Linh Thạch and materials of data/math/drops.json only; xp 0 because its Tu Vi comes from the answers (math_ask.xp_rule). A run of a band of tu vi (realms.json quai, app/systems/realm_quai.py) pays stones x the band's mult.stones (data/math/dia_do.json) and no item above the band's loot_cap.
_chest_comment: The final chest of a won run, rolled by every player on their own. A math bí cảnh pays no xp and no jade: Linh Thạch, data/math/drops.json materials and Linh Quả (its only source since the garden went). Mảnh Bảo Vật (fragments + flawless_fragments per flawless puzzle room, the same count for the whole team) come back in Mặc Ảnh Động only (2026-11-20); like every item of a table they are paid only to a player whose tu vi has unlocked them (data/loot_tiers.json), the others see them as locked. A run of a band pays stones x the band's mult.stones and rolls no item above the band's loot_cap, but for the Mảnh Bảo Vật and the chest's 'treasures' (Linh Quả: its only source), bounded by the realm's own cap (loot_tiers.json source_caps) and the player's tu vi alone.
